title: Add exact complex rank-16 block decoder screen
body:
## Summary

Adds `research/complex-e8-pair-block-climb/`, an exact complex decoder on a
two-root E8 subalphabet and its four-level tensor itinerary through support
ranks 2, 4, 8 and 16. The package verifies the Gaussian-rational identities,
all F2 support-pairing ranks, dense frame inverses, product-root embedding and
left-inverse restoration.

The selected model has 896 live families over nine stages. The corrected
per-call profile is `{16:896/9, 8:8}`: 56 rank-16 blocks per nine-stage
replica, averaging `56/9` blocks per call, with the selected eight rank-8 local
terms retained. Decoder COPY mass is `14336/9` per call and total local profile
mass is `14912/9`. Its parent-model copy-only ceiling bracket is
`[1942057021/250000000000, 1553645617/200000000000]`, above the selected
five-percent target.

## Scope and limits

This is a partial ideal screen, not a supplier or a κ claim. Levels 2–4 are
product-root frames in growing ambient dimension with a new label form; no
embedding into the selected 9-bit, 112-port alphabet is established. The
package lists exact frame, root embedding, restoration and scalar accumulation
counts. A sensitivity that charges one rank-1 unit per staged frame multiply,
addition, embedding coefficient, restoration read and scalar output addition
uses `12824/3` units per call; the pinned relaxation allows 3,919 integer
additional units at the +5% target, so this proxy falls below the selected
endpoint. The parent model has no established tariff translating the linear
frame ledger into COPY rank. Owner chronology, dirty-state consumer,
precision/tape and hosting obligations remain open.

The 56-block accounting is averaged over the nine-stage replica. An earlier
draft charged the whole replica to one call; that was caught in review and the
final exact verifier and JSON result use the corrected average.

This is complementary to #3039/#3066's charged-group and mixed-profile work,
#1633's all-pairs E8 rank boundary, and #3566/#3567's selected-port/tetrad
analysis. It does not duplicate macbook-05's fixed-alphabet effective-rank
bound. The explicit two-root factorization and tensor support/frame ledger are
new; credit PR717, PR968/PR1077, `complex-decoder-field-extension-seed44`,
#3039/#3066 and #1633 for prior conventions and results. Source pins and
provenance are included in `SOURCES.json`.

## Verification

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-e8-pair-block-climb/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/complex-e8-pair-block-climb/verify.py
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-e8-pair-block-climb --check-only
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-e8-pair-block-climb
```

Both direct modes pass with:

```text
PASS_COMPLEX_E8_PAIR_BLOCK_CLIMB levels=4 rank16_block_copy_mass=256 average_profile_mass=14912/9 ideal_a=0.007768228085 frame_proxy_a=0.001658774411
```

The registered replay reports `outcome=partial`; the metadata check explicitly
does not claim mathematical acceptance. No selected-frontier update or κ
improvement is claimed.

Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance by homelab-05. No independent
human review or formal proof-assistant verification is claimed. New material
is Apache-2.0.

Prepared from branch `research/luna-pass-20261018-homelab-05` at local commit
`2e969106d82a7e53ee3a22580653521b4876cc6b`, based on canonical main
`20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/complex-e8-pair-block-climb` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/complex-e8-pair-block-climb --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
